_comment: SAMPLE DATA. Voice notes are a computer voice reading invented lines; photos are credited Wikimedia Commons images, not the user's. Replaced by a real trek.

notes.script: Started from Atkarwadi, still dark, chai stall just opening.
Steep bit now, loose stones, had to use my hands on a couple of rocks.
Sun's up behind us. The whole valley went orange for about a minute.
Langurs on the wall near the gate, three of them, totally unbothered.
Someone selling taak in clay pots just inside the gate. Ice cold.
Fog rolling in from the valley, can't see the road anymore.
Kanda bhaji at the top, earned it.
Back at the bottom. Knees are done, fog on our shoes.
